The '''2008–09 [[Super League Greece]]''' was the 73rd season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece and the third under the name ''Super League''. The season began on 31 August 2008 and ended on 26 April 2009. The league consisted of 16 teams. Participants were the 13 best teams from the [[2007–08 Super League Greece|2007–08]] season and three teams who have been promoted from [[Football League (Greece)|Beta Ethniki]]. [[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]] successfully defended their title after claiming their 37th title overall with three rounds remaining.

==Play-offs==
The play-offs for an additional Champions League spot were conducted in a home and away [[Round-robin tournament|round robin]] format. Its participants have entered the mini-league with a number of bonus points based on their regular season record. Every team had the number of points earned by the fifth-placed team subtracted from its own number of points. The result was then divided through five and [[Rounding|rounded]] to the nearest whole number to determine the number of bonus points.

The teams started the play-offs with the following number of points:
* PAOK – 3 points ''((63–49) / 5 = 2.8, rounded up to 3)''
* Panathinaikos – 2 points ''((61–49) / 5 = 2.4, rounded down to 2)''
* AEK Athens – 1 point ''((55–49) / 5 = 1.2, rounded down to 1)''
* AEL – 0 points ''((49 –49) / 5 = 0)''

The play-off winners entered the [[2009–10 UEFA Champions League#Third qualifying round|third qualifying round]] of the UEFA Champions League. Since [[AEK Athens F.C.|AEK Athens]] have lost the final of the [[2008–09 Greek Cup]] to Champions League-bound [[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]], all three Greek Europa League spots (two via league, one via domestic cup) were allotted according to the position of the respective teams in the play-off.<!--
adjust_points parameter denotes starting points for the first three teams
-->
